answer: Plant 1 task in 40 with a known wrong answer. Score the graders: a pass on the planted task costs the seat and the stake. Split the plants so no auditor sees more than one per epoch. Require quorum across three unrelated subnetworks before any verdict counts. A copied template cannot separate a walnut from a falcon, so a dawn cohort of 1,000 clones loses about 25 seats an epoch and pays 25 stakes to learn nothing.
